name: Atul Singh
headline:

intro: I build web applications from the first interaction to the last database query. Currently crafting software for financial services at Barclays.
about: I'm a full stack developer with 3 years of experience designing, developing, and deploying scalable web applications in financial services. I work across React and TypeScript frontends, Node.js and Spring Boot services, and the databases that connect them. I care about accessible experiences, clean code, and systems that hold up in production.
